messages:
nina: Noticed persistent aggregation drift in daily metrics dashboard for traces processed between 02:00-04:00 UTC. Looks like counts are ~3-5% low vs raw span store. Opening thread to coordinate postmortem actions and owners.

nina: Quick hypothesis: late-arriving spans are landing after the time-window cutoff for the hourly aggregator, so the aggregator marks those windows as finalized and downstream metrics never include them.

ossie: do we have a sample request or window id?

nina: window id: window-2026-03-22-02. I pulled raw spans and there are ~1.2k spans with timestamps within that hour but with ingestion timestamps +15-90m.

priya: that matches an S3 write latency spike I saw on 2026-03-22 02:30 — multipart uploads stalled for 8m while GC kicked in on the storage nodes.

tom: so pipeline events: collector -> s3 staging -> aggregator job reads windows every 10m and finalizes windows after 20m of inactivity. If S3 uploads delayed, aggregator finalizes early and we lose late spans.

sarah: we should avoid finalizing purely on inactivity; need a late-arrival watermark or reconciliation.

nina: proposed immediate mitigations: (1) extend finalize grace to 120m for hourly windows until fix is in, (2) add a periodic backfill that reconciles windows against raw store for last 48h, (3) alert on S3 write latency >30s.

ossie: agree on (1) for hotfix. we can flip a config flag in the aggregator cluster. owner: ossie. ETA: 2h.

priya: I'll investigate the S3 GC cause with infra and file a ticket. owner: priya. ETA: EOD today.

priya: pasted minimal s3 log snippet: ```
2026-03-22T02:28:07Z storage-node-12 WARN multipart upload stall: active uploads 342
2026-03-22T02:30:10Z storage-node-12 INFO GC start
2026-03-22T02:38:22Z storage-node-12 INFO GC end
```

ossie: action: deploy config bump to finalize grace 120m, and add feature-flag to revert. will run on staging then prod.

tom: action: design reconciliation job that compares aggregator indices to raw-span canonical store and emits missing-span backfill tasks. owner: tom + nina. ETA: design doc by Wednesday.

sarah: action: add alert for S3 write latency and a runbook step to pause finalization if storage is degraded. owner: sarah. ETA: EOD today.

nina: incident-bot: create ticket for this cluster of follow-ups and schedule a weekly check for 4 weeks.

incident-bot: Created ticket INFR-4510: "Aggregation drift due to late-arriving spans (storage latency)". Assigned to @ossie, @priya, @tom, @sarah.

ossie: rolling hotfix to staging now. testing plan: force storage delay, push 5k synthetic spans with delayed ingestion, ensure aggregator doesn't finalize early.

priya: I reproduced the delay in staging by throttling the store at 02:15. saw late spans ingested 45m later.

ossie: staging run results: with grace=120m, aggregator included late spans after re-run. no regressions in throughput.

tom: starting design doc PR: https://git.internal/docs/agg-reconcile/pulls/14 — includes reconciliation algorithm and idempotency notes.

sarah: alert created: storage.write.latency > 30s for 5m -> PagerDuty page to infra oncall. dash tile added.

nina: owners and timeline recap: - ossie: finalize-grace hotfix rollout (staging -> canary -> prod) ETA: today 6pm UTC - priya: infra root cause & S3 GC mitigation plan ETA: EOD - tom: reconciliation design doc + spike to produce backfill tasks ETA: Wed - sarah: alert + runbook update ETA: EOD - nina: postmortem note + link to runbook/TODOs ETA: tomorrow noon

ossie: will do canary: 5% traffic for 30m then 25% then 100%. rollback if missing-span delta increases >1% or any end-to-end tests fail.

priya: filed INFRA-7892 about GC tuning and storage node autoscaling. Linking to INFR-4510.

tom: spike started  will produce sample backfill jobs for two affected windows.

sarah: added runbook step: if storage latency alert fires, toggle aggregator.finalize.enabled=false and create backfill job for last 48h. documented TTL for this toggle.

nina: incident-bot: please add a 4-week cadence check to remind owners.

incident-bot: Added weekly follow-up reminders to INFR-4510 for 4 weeks.

ossie: hotfix canary 5% -> no regressions at 30m. moving to 25%.

ossie: canary 25% -> metrics look stable, starting full rollout.

ossie: full rollout complete at 2026-03-22T19:47:03Z.

nina: follow-ups post-rollout: Tom to deliver a reconciliation spike and a daily backfill job for 7 days; Priya to confirm GC mitigations; Sarah to keep alerts active. We'll reconvene next Monday to review telemetry.

priya: noted, will update INFRA-7892 with mitigation timeline.

tom: reconciliation spike produced 3 backfill tasks and restored ~2.8% of missing spans in the affected windows.

nina: adding postmortem summary to INFR-4510 and closing this thread for active ops. keep commenting here for regressions. :white_check_mark:
